items.title:
com.cloudforgeci:cloudforge-api 3.3.9 发布, Bill of Materials (BOM) for CloudForge — import as type pom / scope import.
    Reactor modules: cloudforge-core, cloudforge-api. cloudforge-ministack and cloudforge-localstack
    live in their own repos (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-ministack, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-localstack),
    declaring this pom as their Maven parent, but are not managed BOM coordinates here and
    cloudforge-api has no dependency on either — see publish-release-branch.yml, which publishes
    them as a side effect of a cfc-core release, the only relationship cfc-core has to them.
    cloudforge-manager-deployment and cloudforge-manager are also not part of this
    BOM/reactor — split into their own private repos
    (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager-deployment, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager), each with a
    standalone pom.xml and independent versioning.
    See docs/architecture/cloudforge-sample-bom.template.md and
    docs/architecture/module-boundaries-and-refactor.plan.md.

com.withorb.api:orb-java 1.42.0 发布, Orb's API is built with the following principles in mind:

1. **Predictable developer experience**: Where applicable, the Orb API uses
   industry-standard patterns such as cursor-based pagination and standardized
   error output. To help with debugging in critical API actions, the API always
   strives to provide detailed and actionable error messages. Aliases such as
   external customer IDs aid in fast integration times.
2. **Reliably real time**: Orb's event-based APIs, such as event ingestion are
   designed to handle extremely high throughput and scale with concurrent load.
   Orb also provides a real-time event-level credits ledger and a highly
   performant webhooks architecture.
3. **Flexibility at the forefront**: Features like timezone localization and the
   ability to amend historical usage show the flexible nature of the platform.

You can download the latest OpenAPI spec
[here](https://api.withorb.com/spec.json) - pass `?version=3.0` for an OpenAPI
3.0-compatible spec.
